opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.3.1: Introduce the topic and opinion, organize a list of reasons, connect them using linking words/phrases, and conclude.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.3.1: Use grammatical word classes, regular/irregular verbs and agreement; form simple, compound and complex sentences.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.3.2: Apply capitalization, possessives, commas/quotation marks in dialogue and grade-appropriate spelling.
opinion.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.3.3: Choose words/phrases for effect; distinguish spoken from written usage where observable.
